status: prospective post-v1 efficiency follow-up locked before execution; synthetic propensity-weighted audit study, not independent confirmation
research_question: Can randomized proxy-only audit propensities reduce trusted-label cost while preserving an unbiased verifier/truth alignment estimate?
true_reward: Bernoulli(0.5), deterministic resampling until both classes occur

verifier_geometry.construction: same fixed-error-norm alignment construction as equal_kl_alignment_stress

selection.scheme: independent Bernoulli inclusion with known propensities; propensities depend only on baseline probabilities and free proxy scores, never on trusted reward
selection.proxy_leverage_objective: minimize sum_i (p_i*abs(v_i-E_p[v])/pi_i)^2 subject to sum_i pi_i=expected_budget and 0.01<=pi_i<=1

primary_prediction: at expected budget 16, proxy_leverage has strictly smaller mean confidence radius than uniform in both arms and pooled decisive rate at least as high; wrong-sign decisive rate <=0.08 for every method/arm
reporting: retain every task/method/arm/budget row, selected identities, expected and realized labels, propensities, estimate, exact covariance, CI, decision and wrong-sign indicator
interpretation: this certifies finite-support or finite-rollout-batch covariance under randomized known propensities; deterministic priority selection without propensities remains invalid
scope: synthetic audit-efficiency study; not a population guarantee for an LLM policy and not evidence of a learned verifier
